stories.summary: Gulf Air and Saudia are both opposing Adani Airport Holdings’ proposal to reduce capacity at Mumbai and shift a significant portion of the international operations to Navi Mumbai. stories.summary: Organised by the National Book Trust (NBT), India, in association with the Ministry of Education and the Maharashtra government, the festival is the first such event in the city. stories.summary: Russo Brothers' Avengers: Doomsday is all set to release on December 17, 2026, in India. The first show of the film in Mumbai will start at midnight, and theatres will be operating for 24 hours, as shows of the movie are going to take place round the clock.

stories.title: Mumbai: 12,000 kg of waste collected over weekend in Versova beach clean up
stories.summary: Mumbai's citizen-led beach clean-up initiative, covering Versova and Dana Pani beaches , has nearly completed 610 weeks, with volunteers continuing their efforts to keep the city’s coastline free of marine debris. Over the weekend, the group collected nearly 12,000 kg of waste from Versova beach, of which around 10-15 per cent was recyclable.

stories.title: 52-year-old stabbed in chest during fight between commuters on Mumbai local; accused held
stories.summary: A 52-year-old man was stabbed inside a Mumbai local train at Andheri station on Sunday during a fight between two other passengers, police said. The accused, 25-year-old Shivaji Laxman Gaikwad, has been arrested, they added. The injured man, Suresh Dwarka Sharma, a carpenter and a native of Hazaribagh in Jharkhand, living in Dharavi was travelling to Borivali East to meet a client.

stories.title: BMC patients to get access to 37 beds at Parel's Global Hospital
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has decided to reserve 37 beds at Global Hospital in Parel for eligible patients nominated by the civic body. A memorandum of understanding (MoU) between the BMC and the hospital is set to be signed in the presence of Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde.

stories.title: How visits by British Princes of Wales shaped Mumbai’s history and architecture
stories.summary: Shedding light on the previous visits of Princes of Wales to the city since the late 19th century, Vinayak Talwar, ambassador of Mumbai, Khaki Tours, in an interview with mid-day, delved into how the historical legacies of each such royal figure are reflected in Mumbai, where several landmarks bear their names.

stories.title: Avengers: Doomsday Advance Bookings Open In India; Shows In Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru And Other Cities Fill Up
stories.summary: The countdown to Marvel's next big superhero spectacle has officially begun in India. Advance bookings for Avengers: Doomsday opened at midnight on Tuesday, and the film has already started witnessing a strong response, with several shows filling up quickly across major cities. The film, which is scheduled to arrive in Indian cinemas on December 17, will release a day before its US debut.

stories.summary: According to a report, India's commercial buildings present significant value opportunities through retrofitting for modernisation. Mumbai's office stock is eligible for considerable asset valuation increases, potentially raising values by 96%. stories.title: Thane to host 27th Mayor's Cup National Photography Exhibition from November 19
stories.summary: Thane is set to host the 27th Thane Mayor’s Cup National Photography Exhibition, ‘Aavishkar 2026’, from November 19 to 22, 2026. The exhibition will showcase some of the finest photographs selected from over 7,000 entries submitted by photographers across the country.

stories.summary: Businesswoman Isha Ambani recently hosted an intimate dinner in Mumbai to welcome American fashion designer Tory Burch during her visit to India. Mr. Modi, speaking at the India-ASEAN summit, said New Delhi's commitment to the grouping's unity and centrality in the partnership "is and will remain steadfast."

stories.summary: A forensic expert has said he believes that convicted sex offender Jeffery Epstein's death in prison was the result of a homicide, not suicide. stories.summary: Bird flu has been confirmed at two poultry farms in Alappuzha district of Keralam, and authorities will begin culling around 26,000 birds on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) to prevent the spread of the infection, officials said. stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Tuesday dismissed the Uttar Pradesh government’s appeal against the Allahabad high court’s decision to stay Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Azam Khan’s conviction and sentence in a fake birth certificate case. stories.title: Maharashtra NCP MLAs, MLCs pledge one month's salary for drought-hit farmers
stories.summary: Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) legislators from the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council on Tuesday decided to donate one month's salary to the Chief Minister's Relief Fund to support farmers affected by drought in the state. The legislators handed over cheques to Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis during the state cabinet meeting at Mantralaya.

stories.title: Sharad Kapoor alleges people filmed donation videos and took the money back
stories.summary: Sharad Kapoor, who recently sought financial help and work amid his failing health, has now complained that some people are using his situation to create social media content. Teams from the Delhi Fire Department, Delhi Police and ambulance services rushed to the scene and rescued around seven to eight people.

stories.title: 12 killed in twin Uttarakhand road accidents as bus and Bolero plunge into deep gorges
stories.summary: At least 12 people were killed and 32 others injured in two separate road accidents in Uttarakhand within hours of each other. In Tehri Garhwal, a passenger bus plunged into a 100-metre-deep gorge, killing eight people and injuring dozens. Later in Rudraprayag district, four people died and six were injured when a Bolero vehicle carrying wedding guests fell into a 500-metre-deep gorge.

stories.title: Tata Trusts Rift: Jimmy Tata Backs Chandra's Third Term, Tata Sons Listing
stories.summary: Jimmy N Tata, younger brother of the late Ratan Tata, has reportedly supported N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons Chairman and the proposed listing of the group's holding company amid disagreements within Tata Trusts. stories.title: Maharashtra: Judicial Employees Threaten Indefinite Strike From November 17 Over Pending Pay Revision
stories.summary: Judicial employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, November 17th bringing court-related work to a standstill as more than 2,000 employees of district and subordinate courts, including Pune District Court at Shivajinagar, stayed away from work to demand equal pay for equal work. The employees are demanding that the Maharashtra Government approve a revised pay-scale proposal granting them salary benefits on a par with employees of the Bombay High Court.

stories.title: Kareena Kapoor, Hrithik Roshan reunite after 23 years? Here's the truth
stories.summary: Karan Johar has sparked fresh excitement among fans of 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham' with a new video hinting at something special around the film. stories.title: Maharashtra: Force One commando unit brought under ATS
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has placed Force One, the state's specialised commando unit, under the administrative and operational control of the Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) . This move from the Maharashtra government aims to improve coordination and ensure unified leadership in counter-terrorism operations.

stories.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Suneha Sharma remanded to police custody till November 21
stories.summary: A Special Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) court in Mumbai on Monday extended the police custody of Suneha Sharma (Suneha Pandit), the sister-in-law of wanted gang leader Anil Pandit, until November 21. Meanwhile, five other accused were remanded to judicial custody after their police custody ended.

stories.title: Nashik: 27-Year-Old Woman Dies After Saree Catches Fire While Bursting Firecrackers
stories.summary: A 27-year-old woman died after her saree caught fire while she was bursting firecrackers outside her home in the Mahatma Nagar area of Nashik. The incident occurred on Nov 8, days after the main Diwali celebrations and Lakshmi Pujan.
